heading, Quantitative Analysis of Whole Lung Health, level 3
Automated analysis of density and volume in each pulmonary lobe, providing real-time monitoring of lung health.

The system performs precise analysis of abnormal densities across the entire lung, which could assist physicians in identifying abnormalities such as emphysema, ILD and other irregular density patterns,
as well as supporting accurate screening of individuals at high risk for lung cancer.
heading, Checking for Big 3 diseases, level 3

Quantitative imaging of lung nodule growth (an imaging biomarker for lung cancer), emphysema (a type of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease COPD), coronary artery calcification CAC (a biomarker of cardiovascular disease)
